finding: Discovered the exact cause of the history mismatch and continuity failures in Package 102: Abaqus *INITIAL CONDITIONS, TYPE=SOLUTION only reads up to 8 entries per data line, silently ignoring variables on single lines beyond field 8. In M1_C5_PACKAGE102_STAGGERED_REEQUIL.inp, all 13 fields were on one line, so SVARS(9..12) remained 0.0, zeroing out SV_H_COMMITTED and SV_H_TRIAL on all 4,440 quads and causing SDV2 to match instantaneous POS_M(u) instead of the transferred history field.
